title: Part III without the item slide: Monkey Island from the beach to the idol field with Herman's key, the navigator head and its necklace (normal puzzles: catapult bananas, dam blast, two ropes and the oars, capture and escape, the monkey on the nose, idol, navigator dialogue, leaflet, banana picker)

entry.notes: First frame in room 20 after the Part III card (global/script-107.txt [0112]-[016D]). room-020-main-beac/entry.txt [0073]-[00A6] has set VAR_VERB_SCRIPT=201 (var 32 == 201), parked the key 269 and memo 272 with owner 14 ([0090]-[0098]) and started the arrival intro local 202 (an override the bridge's automatic Esc skips). NO ITEM SLIDE: every cutscene takes input away, inputs are only taken while user input is on. Inventory = the S4 exit (routes/anypercent/S4-part2.json exit.inventory): 488 pieces of eight, 395 breath mints, 643 staple remover, 752 T-shirt, 596 cotton T-shirt, 907 LeChuck's note, 732 magnetic compass, 901 pamphlet, 902 leaflet, 903 brochure, 82 ink, 74 dusty book. Used in S5: 732 (strikes the flint at the dam) and 902 (traded to the natives for the navigator head). Var[143] == 20 (global/script-001.txt [082C]): the rowboat 263 lies at the main beach and needs the oars (room-020-main-beac/entry.txt [002A]-[0059], local-200.txt [0000]-[0091]). Var[242] == 2 (catapult aim, global/script-001.txt [0851]). The monkey (actor 2) waits on map room 2 near (151,126) (room-020-main-beac/local-202.txt [00C9]; room-002-monkey-1/local-202.txt, local-200.txt). Var[145] == 0 (bananas given). Island layout that fixes the order: the cannibal village side (room 6 land boxes 1-11, room 4 boxes 1-12, room 3 boxes 20-25, village 25, hut 27, beach 132) is a separate land mass from the fort, fork, pond, crack, main beach and clearing (room 2 boxes 1-9, room 3 boxes 1-19, room 4 boxes 13-19, room 5 boxes 1-7) (BOXM of LFLF_0002..0006; room-003-monkey-2/entry.txt [00D3]-[0140], room-004-monkey-3/entry.txt [0129]-[01A8], room-006-monkey-5/entry.txt [005B]-[00B4]), so every crossing is by rowboat, which needs the oars, which need two ropes, one of which needs the dam blast. The monkey needs all five bananas in the game (three on the main beach after the catapult, two in the village), so the village must be visited before the monkey and again with the idol: four boat crossings in all. Order mirrors the runner sources' pre-slide guide (docs/research/anypercent-runner-sources.md section 2.5, steps 1-13).
